adapter_targets.integration_requirement: Wrap query_obsidian_context as a read-only memory source for intake/context router preview.
Use existing /v1/context/obsidian/query route for preview context where route calls are authorized.
Use context index as a source registry in router preview.
Use safe context inventory for repo/evidence source discovery.
Read prior receipts by path and summarize only scoped evidence relevant to intake.
Reference run IDs and canonical labels without rewriting run records.
Attach truth labels and evidence-strength metadata to memory-selected context.

phase_3_handoff_requirements: Build intake/context router preview only after approval.
Use existing context and Obsidian systems before creating new modules.
Return preview packets with source refs, privacy level, truth labels, and unverified checks.
Do not write Obsidian or evidence outside the authorized root.
Do not start workers or provider calls from context routing.
